description: Source code for a configuration script handling menu-driven configuration options, including parsing, user interaction, and configuration management functions.

methods.name: print_help
methods.description: Prints extended help for a menu item.

methods.name: strip
methods.description: Removes leading and trailing whitespace from a string.

methods.name: xfgets
methods.description: Helper function to read a line from a file, with error handling.

methods.name: set_randconfig_seed
methods.description: Sets a seed for random configuration generation based on environment or current time.

methods.name: randomize_choice_values
methods.description: Randomly selects a choice value within a choice symbol.

methods.name: conf_set_all_new_symbols
methods.description: Sets all symbols to a specified default mode (yes, no, mod, random).

methods.name: conf_rewrite_tristates
methods.description: Rewrites tristate values from old to new across symbols.

methods.name: conf_askvalue
methods.description: Prompts user for a value of a symbol.

methods.name: conf
methods.description: Main recursive function to process a menu item based on its type.

methods.name: check_conf
methods.description: Checks and possibly restarts configuration process for symbols needing user input.

methods.name: conf_usage
methods.description: Prints usage information for the configuration tool.
